# Codex version output fixture

`codex-cli-0.153.3.txt` is the stdout of the installed `codex --version`
captured on September 5, 2026. This command makes no model request. It is
the accepted version-probe wire shape, not a manually invented provider response.

`participant-items.ndjson` preserves the event/item field shapes from retained
Codex terminal executions on September 14–15, 2026. Message, command, search,
and file-change records use synthetic IDs, text, commands, output, queries, and
paths. The records are selected individually; they do not depict a live study.
No participant prose or source data is copied. There is no retained reasoning
record in this fixture, so it does not establish live reasoning-event coverage.
